name: ssh-tools
description: SSH hosts, commands, SFTP transfers and tunnels for Claude Code. Per-project and global host files, encrypted credentials, password/key/agent authentication, scanned config and one-command diagnostics.

nodeBin.title: Node binary
nodeBin.description: Node 18+ used to run the bundled ssh helper. Empty uses node on PATH.

defaultTimeoutSec.title: Default command timeout (s)
defaultTimeoutSec.description: Timeout for ssh_exec when the call does not give one. Clamped to 1-590.

allowCmdSecrets.title: Allow cmd: secret references
allowCmdSecrets.description: Let a host read its password from a shell command (cmd:...). Off by default because it executes local commands.
